newsitem.title: UK: Coral shares slide after trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Coral shares slide after trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Coral Products Plc fell sharply on Tuesday after the company said it expected pre-tax profits for the year to April 30, 1997 to not be less that 950,000 stg.
The share price lost 14-1/2p by 1403 GMT to stand at 44p.
The company said it intended to maintain the final dividend payout of not less than 1.5p per share making a total of 2.25p, unchanged from the previous year.

Coral, which manufactures injection moulded plastic products, said since the end of February it had experienced both a decline in and deferment of, orders. It added that the strength of sterling had in some cases forced it to reduce prices.
